subject: Next steps: token targets, unit economics & service composition for HoloWare POC
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@holoware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: token targets, unit economics & service composition for HoloWare POC

Hi Kate — great to connect earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: 6-week POC to validate question-answering and search augmentation in the HoloWare support flow.
- Expected traffic: 18k active users/month, peak 350 concurrent sessions.
- Typical prompt lengths: 40–120 tokens; expected average per interaction (prompt+response): ~900 tokens.

Cost & budget check
- You mentioned a comfort range of roughly $22k–$50k/month for this POC.
- Target unit-econ: ideally <$1,000 per 1M tokens for the first phase; we can show paths to $600/1M with batching + quantized variants at scale.

Proposed model mix (initial):
- 60% high-quality chat for customer-facing answers (chat-large, higher per-token cost)
- 30% cost-optimized chat for routine confirmations and follow-ups (chat-medium)
- 8% embeddings for semantic search + rerank (embed-1)
- 2% explicit rerank calls for top-K ordering (rerank-v1)

Prelim monthly token math (rough):
- 18k users * avg 15 interactions/mo = 270k interactions
- 270k * 900 tokens = 243M tokens/mo
- At $1,000 / 1M tokens -> ~$243k/mo (too high for POC)
- With service-layer routing + 3:1 batching and 50% traffic to chat-medium -> estimated $32k–$46k/mo (fits your stated band).

Attachments: attached a simple modeling sheet (HoloWare_MVP_token_model.xlsx) with adjustable knobs for interactions, token estimates, and model mixes.

Next steps I suggest
1) You confirm the monthly active user and average interactions assumptions (or send corrected numbers).
2) We deliver a revised token-econ sheet with two scenarios (conservative / optimized) and a recommended split by model.
3) Schedule a short architecture + security sync (30m) next week so your security team can surface any compliance asks early.

If that sounds good I’ll update the workbook and send a proposed mutual action plan and dates.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: [HoloWare_MVP_token_model.xlsx]

From: Kate Miller <kate@holoware.com>

Date: 2026-06-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: token targets, unit economics & service composition for HoloWare POC

Hey Rafael — thanks for the recap and for the model. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 18k number is MAU across our web + mobile; usable interactions for the first phase will be closer to 10k MAU (we’ll only roll out to beta customers).
- Average interactions per active user will likely be 8–10 in the first month, not 15.
- We absolutely need the initial POC to stay below $50k/month, ideally closer to $30k.

On model mix: we agree with a layered approach but want to bias more to the cost-optimized variant early — can you run a scenario with 40% high-quality chat / 50% cost-optimized / 8% embeddings / 2% rerank? Also curious what the 1M-token cost looks like if we pin chat-medium as the default.

Security/Procurement
- Procurement will want a short statement of data handling (is session text persisted by default?) and a SOC2 timeline. Procurement cc’d here.

Timing: we can do the security sync Wed 6/16 at 11am PT. I’ll loop in our engineering manager if useful.

-Kate
Kate Miller | Head of Product, HoloWare
procurement@holoware.com

Thanks Kate — appreciate the clarifications. I updated the workbook with two scenarios attached: conservative (higher HQ share) and cost-optimized (your requested bias). Summary below (rounded):

Scenario A — conservative (60/30/8/2) with 10k MAU, 9 interactions/user
- Estimated tokens/mo: 81M
- Cost (mix blended): $78k/mo -> approx $960 / 1M tokens

Scenario B — cost-optimized (40/50/8/2) with 10k MAU, 9 interactions/user
- Estimated tokens/mo: 81M
- Cost (mix blended + batching & caching estimates): $34k/mo -> approx $420 / 1M tokens

Key levers that get us from A->B:
- Route deterministic queries to chat-medium (cheaper model) and only elevate hard queries to chat-large.
- Aggressive prefix and KV caching for repeated support flows.
- Use embeddings + local rerank to reduce full-chat invocations for search-like queries.

Action items I’ll take now:
- Finalize and share the updated sheet (attached) with the two scenarios and a per-model per-month token breakout.
- Draft a 1-page data handling note for procurement and include our SOC2 status and next steps.
- Put the security sync on Wednesday 6/16 11am PT (invites to follow).

Would be helpful if procurement can send any mandatory contract must-haves ahead of the security call (retention max, allowed vendors, encryption requirements).

Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
